answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor reputation to verifiable work history instead of raw identity count. Like a jetty that only holds when every timber is proven under load, an agent earns weight by completing attested tasks over time, while fresh fake accounts pile up with zero history. Reputation decays like umber pigment fading in sunlight unless refreshed by real work, and the velvet-smooth onboarding of a brand-new identity buys nothing without that earned record. One agent, one history, one weight.
